Age

Adults (18-64 years)
Elderly (65 years and older)

Inclusion criteria

Female, 40 years or older, breast cancer, ER positive tumor, HER2-negative 
tumor, maximal tumorsize 2 cm, Bloom Richardson grade 1 or 2, no (lympho)vascular invasion

Exclusion criteria

Indication for chemotherapy, lobular carcinoma, previous breast cancer, lymph
node or distant metastasis, breast cancer gene mutation, previous irradiation
of chest wall, breast implant.
